title: Derive safe deterministic Credits from approved media provenance records
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md, docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md and the task sourceRefs before editing. This is an independent leaf in the B001–B100 cohort, not an integration or completed feature claim. Implement only the owned source and tests, using the exact pinned API section in PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS. No imports from unmerged A/B modules, no manifests/barrels/App.tsx/shared task metadata edits and no new dependencies. Locally declare the contract's shared structural types; package engine/protocol production stays ES2022-only and pure, with no Firebase, browser, Node, UI, credentials, wall clock or global randomness. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, deployment, credential access, task-issue mutation or budget changes. Implement creditsEntries exactly as frozen in section B095 of docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md. Include approved records only; deduplicate exact creator/source/license/attribution tuples and sort lexicographically by those raw strings for reproducibility. Unapproved entries and duplicate semantic references cannot silently gain release approval; empty inventory is honest.
Malformed/duplicate semantic keys and overlong/control provenance fail; outputs omit private staging paths and do not mutate records.
The exported implementation matches the frozen local structural API, preserves legacy APIs, and changes only declared ownership; no unresolved rule is silently decided.
